posts.title: Use AI to Be a Better Human
posts.description: AI has the potential to be a potent de-humanizer. I’m convicted that it can be an even more potent humanizer.

posts.title: Restoring Together

posts.title: How AI Turned Six Months of Work into 16 Minutes - Artifical Insights
posts.description: Daniel Manary recently interviewed me on his podcast, Artificial Insights . We talked about some of the ways we at Waha have been able to deploy AI tools to save our non-profit literally years worth of work as we pursue our organizational goals. It was a great chat!
